name: Gorvax
bible: A hulking, hunched chimera-engine warrior: enormous and heavy-boned, shoulders far wider than his head, a low forward-leaning stance. Head: a lion-like skull with a tawny muzzle of short fur, a dark iron brow plate, two glowing RED eyes deep under the brow, a snarl of long ivory fangs with thin steam venting from the jaw, and two curved dark goat HORNS sweeping back from the crown. A thick MANE of black riveted cables with tarnished BRASS rings falls from the skull over the shoulders and back. Armour: scuffed DARK IRON-GREY plates over chest and shoulders, brass-riveted stacked pauldrons, a black leather harness, brass-trimmed greaves and black boots. A segmented iron SERPENT tail trails low behind him, its links edged dull red. WEAPON: an ENGINE-HAMMER, a dark iron piston shaft as long as his body from hip to head with two brass collars, ending in a squat iron block as big as his chest, with a glowing red core in its face and a riveted brass band. Always held in BOTH hands: right hand low near the butt, left hand above it, the head out in front. Effects and weapon trails: RED-ORANGE embers, steam and sparks with a crimson glow.
design:
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right; a combat stance with the hammer ready; a lumbering walking pose; a charging run; a leaping jump with the hammer back; a close-up of the engine-hammer head
- middle rows: six attack poses: two heavy overhead hammer smashes, a wide sideways hammer sweep, a ground slam with cracked earth, an airborne hammer swing, a Blood Frenzy rage pose; red embers and steam in each
- bottom row: guard with the hammer across the body, hit reaction, knocked down, victory pose with the hammer planted, the Blood Frenzy aura at full force

atk-a.title: Heavy basic smashes 1 and 2 (3 frames each)
frames: combo smash 1, anticipation: both hands raising the hammer high overhead, weight shifting onto the back foot, the head far back
combo smash 1, strike: a crushing overhead smash, the hammer head crashing down in front, a red dust burst and embers kept inside this cell
combo smash 1, recovery: the hammer dragged down toward the ground, the body settling back toward stance
combo smash 2, anticipation: the hammer wound back low across the body, torso twisted, shoulders coiled
combo smash 2, strike: a wide, heavy horizontal sweep at waist height, the hammer head flat across the air, a red arc of embers kept inside this cell
combo smash 2, recovery: the follow-through pulling the hammer round, body rocking forward, steam venting

atk-b.title: Combo finisher and aerial smash (3 frames each)
frames: combo finisher, anticipation: a huge wind-up, the hammer raised high over the head in both hands, one foot stepping in
combo finisher, strike: the hammer slammed straight down into the ground in front, cracked earth and a shockwave of dust kept inside this cell, the strongest pose
combo finisher, recovery: wrenching the hammer free from the ground, body hunched over, steam and sparks
aerial smash, anticipation: airborne, hammer raised behind the head with both hands
aerial smash, strike: a sweeping mid-air hammer blow forward and down, a red arc of embers kept inside this cell
aerial smash, recovery: airborne, body hunched and compact, hammer tucked in front, returning to a ready pose

atk-c.title: Plunge and heavy attack (3 frames each)
frames: plunge, dive: in mid-air diving headfirst, the hammer held overhead with its head pointing down, red speed lines
plunge, impact: landing in a low crouch, the hammer head driven into the ground, sparks and a burst of dust kept inside this cell
plunge, recovery: rising from the impact, the hammer dragged back toward stance
heavy attack, charge: body coiled low, the hammer drawn back low behind the hip, the red core glowing and steam pouring from the plate seams
heavy attack, strike: a devastating upward swing, the hammer rising from low in front to high overhead, a huge trail of red embers kept inside this cell
heavy attack, follow-through: deep follow-through with the hammer raised high, steam and embers dissipating

sheetNotes.idle: The mane cables and the steam from the jaw sway and drift with each breath; the hammer head stays low and steady in both hands.
sheetNotes.run: Heavy, lumbering strides, the body low and leaning forward; the hammer is carried low in both hands near the ground, the mane and tail bouncing with each step. Keep the serpent tail coiled close behind his legs in EVERY frame, never reaching past his own cell (neighbouring frames must not touch).
sheetNotes.art: Blood Frenzy, six seconds of rage: anticipation 1, he roars, the mane cables glow red-hot and steam bursts from every plate seam; anticipation 2, a crimson rage aura erupts around him, the eyes blazing, the hammer raised; execution 1, he slams the hammer down and a huge red shockwave of rage bursts outward, kept inside the cell; execution 2, full frenzy, the hammer high and crimson embers swirling around him, kept inside the cell; recovery 1, the aura fades into steam; recovery 2, he stands tall with the hammer resting on his shoulder, still faintly glowing.
sheetNotes.misc: Skill throw: he tears a smouldering iron canister from his harness and hurls it forward with one arm. Taunt: he thumps his chest with a fist and roars, the mane flaring, then drags the hammer head across the ground in a shower of sparks. Victory: he plants the hammer head-down in front of him with one fist raised, roaring, steam rising from the jaw and seams, the cables settling.
sheetNotes.ko: Intro: he lumbers in with the hammer lowered and dragging, head down; he raises the hammer onto his shoulder and roars, steam bursting from the jaw; he swings the hammer round in a flourish and slams its butt into the ground; he settles into a low, hunched stance with the cables swinging.
